content: Backdoors & Breaches visual guide v2: one-page-per-topic visual guide with annotated card anatomy ('Reading the Cards': title, description, procedures that detect it, tools, resources), sequence of play (Discussion, Decision, Rolling, Outcome), and a full worked example gameplay page. Incident Captain crafts opening scenario 'detailed enough to give Defenders a place to start, without giving away the specifics of any Attack cards'; cards revealed one at a time on detection; full chain revealed at end. Defenders may ask clarifying questions without cost.
